initial_application: Commit ededc6fc845f772bb45c2d3b1e4e7b105c2e3d19 applied the issue by deleting source/namingsystem/namingsystem-registry.xml and removing the NamingSystem/registry entry from source/namingsystem/list-NamingSystem-examples.xml.
additional_context: NamingSystem is still an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so the original files were in current build scope. FHIR-37889 is the same removal family for NamingSystem registry and terminology bundles and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-I minutes support removal, and Zulip searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source has no tracked namingsystem-registry file and no source references to namingsystem-registry, NamingSystem/registry, or a registry Bundle id.
